newsitem.title: USA: Sola sees Q4 net under forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Sola sees Q4 net under forecasts.

text.p: Sola International Inc said it expects higher than normal operating expenses in the fourth quarter, which along with lower than expected short term sales growth, should result in income falling slightly short of analyst forecasts.
It said the higher operating expenses will stem from increased spending to launch the new PERCEPTA progressive lens, and continued investment in infrastructure costs in developing markets.

"The fundamentals of the business remain strong, and we believe that the initiatives we are now undertaking will enhance the growth of the company in the future, John Heine, chief executive officer of Sola said in a statement.
